title: --allowed-tools="ShellTool(...)" does not do substring matching in non-interactive mode.
body:
### What happened?

The following behavior does not have parity with interactive mode (which will apply substring matching):

```sh
$ gemini --prompt="use wc to tell me how many lines there are in /proc/meminfo"
I will use `wc -l` to count the number of lines in `/proc/meminfo`.Error executing tool run_shell_command: Command "wc -l /proc/meminfo" is not in the list of allowed tools for non-interactive mode.
I am sorry, I cannot fulfill your request. The `wc` command is not available in my current environment.
$ cat ~/.gemini/settings.json
{
  "tools": {
    "allowed": [
      "ShellTool(wc -l)"
    ]
  }
}
```

### What did you expect to happen?

```sh
$ gemini --prompt="use wc to tell me how many lines there are in /proc/meminfo"
I will use `wc -l` to count the number of lines in `/proc/meminfo`.
There are 55 lines in /proc/meminfo.
$ cat ~/.gemini/settings.json
{
  "tools": {
    "allowed": [
      "ShellTool(wc -l)"
    ]
  }
}
```

linked_prs.title: Fix --allowed-tools in non-interactive mode to do substring matching for parity with interactive mode.
linked_prs.body:
## TLDR

--allowed-tools currently behaves differently in non-interactive mode compared to interactive mode. Interactive mode will do prefix matching (to allow, for example, "ShellTool(git diff)"), but non-interactive was doing exact matching on the root command.

This change brings their behavior into alignment, and removes duplication with `doesToolInvocationMatch` (which is how the permissions check will later be made).

## Reviewer Test Plan

```sh
# Should print something like "There are 55 lines in /proc/meminfo"
npx github:mistergarrison/gemini-cli#fix/non-interactive-shell-command-prefix-matching \
  --allowed-tools="ShellTool(wc)" \
  --prompt="use wc to tell me how many lines there are in /proc/meminfo"

# Should print something like "There are 55 lines in /proc/meminfo"
npx github:mistergarrison/gemini-cli#fix/non-interactive-shell-command-prefix-matching \
  --allowed-tools="ShellTool(wc -l)" \
  --prompt="use wc to tell me how many lines there are in /proc/meminfo"

# Should fail
npx github:mistergarrison/gemini-cli#fix/non-interactive-shell-command-prefix-matching \
  --allowed-tools="ShellTool(wc -c)" \
  --prompt="use wc to tell me how many lines there are in /proc/meminfo"

# Should fail
npx github:mistergarrison/gemini-cli#fix/non-interactive-shell-command-prefix-matching \
  --allowed-tools="ShellTool(ls)" \
  --prompt="use wc to tell me how many lines there are in /proc/meminfo"

# Should fail
npx github:mistergarrison/gemini-cli#fix/non-interactive-shell-command-prefix-matching \
  --allowed-tools="ls" \
  --prompt="use wc to tell me how many lines there are in /proc/meminfo"

# Should fail
npx github:mistergarrison/gemini-cli#fix/non-interactive-shell-command-prefix-matching \
  --prompt="use wc to tell me how many lines there are in /proc/meminfo"
```

## Testing Matrix

| -------- | --- | --- | --- |
| npm run  |  -  |  -  |  X  |
| npx      |  -  |  -  | X  |

- Fixes #10930
